title.value: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products

date.provenance: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products. 2  Effective Date.  This act shall take effect July 1, 2025.

pfas_definition.value: a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom
pfas_definition.provenance: IV.  The department may request a certificate of compliance from a manufacturer of rugs, carpets, or aftermarket stain and water resistant treatments.  Within 30 days after receipt of the department's request for a certificate of compliance, the manufacturer shall: (a) Provide the department with a certificate attesting that the manufacturer's product or products comply with the requirements of this chapter; or (b) Notify persons who are selling a product of the manufacturer's in this state that the sale is prohibited because the product does not comply with this chapter and submit to the department a list of the names and addresses of those persons notified.
